record.question: Transform the given sentences as directed: He has promised never to touch wine again. (Affirmative)
options: He has promised not to touch wine again.
He promised to not drink wine again.
He has promised to abstain from wine in future.
He has promised that he will not touch wine again.
record.explanation: Answer C: He has promised to abstain from wine in future.. “To abstain from wine” restates “never to touch wine” affirmatively while preserving the promise. Independent check: “Abstain from wine” expresses the same commitment without the negative “never to touch wine.” Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/abstain.
